verdict.rationale: The README offers one security-relevant statement: the bundled helper scripts are six standard-library Python files and none touch the network. That partly addresses what executes and implies no network-based data collection, but it is not a security-posture document. Missing for 10: a dedicated security or trust-model section, a trust model for third-party skills, an explicit telemetry/data-collection policy, and a full account of what the skills can execute (shell, file writes, deploy actions).

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, the project documents its security posture — what skills can execute, the trust model for third-party skills, and any telemetry or data collection

citations.quote: Six of them, all standard-library Python. None touch the network.
